name: Video Evidence Workbench
north_star: Turn a video into a human-reviewable shot dataset and provenance-backed evidence package on the user's machine.

growth_goal.target: Build the product and adoption foundation for a possible 2000 GitHub stars.
measurement: qualified repository visitor to star conversion

stories.title: Real project data is never replaced by plausible demo content
acceptanceCriteria: API, timeout, and schema failures are visible and retryable
The workspace shows its backend data source
Shot count, timecodes, frames, readiness, and deliverables match project files

stories.title: One local command serves the production React workspace and API
acceptanceCriteria: The built frontend is served from the same localhost origin as the API
SPA routes, static assets, API routes, and project files remain isolated
Legacy HTML remains an explicit fallback when no frontend build exists

stories.title: Every project exports an evidence-first Codex companion package
acceptanceCriteria: reports/codex_handoff.md is deterministic and contains no private absolute path
data/visualization_dataset.json cites shot IDs, timecodes, and evidence references
The files explicitly mark unverified items and do not claim that Codex or visualization ran

stories.title: Desktop and mobile review surfaces expose the same evidence truth
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop centers the player, shot strip, inspector, evidence table, and readiness
Mobile uses Video, Shots, Evidence, and Export modes instead of stacked desktop panels
Controls are keyboard-visible, touch targets are at least 44px, and the page does not overflow horizontally

stories.title: The repository has an honest open-source release surface
acceptanceCriteria: README, MIT license, contribution, security, conduct, citation, issue, PR, and CI files exist
Product language contains no internal pricing, simulated payment, or fake provider success claim
SEO and GEO assets explain the product with stable Markdown, FAQ, and llms.txt

stories.title: Fresh install works on macOS, Linux, and Windows or declares an exact support boundary
acceptanceCriteria: A clean environment installs without relying on the maintainer's existing tools
One licensed or synthetic sample reaches the same normalized output on supported platforms
Unsupported codecs and optional tools fail with actionable messages

stories.title: A reproducible 20-video evaluation reports boundary and package quality
acceptanceCriteria: The fixture set covers fast cuts, fades, animation, vertical video, VFR, and speech-heavy clips
The benchmark publishes timing, boundary error, missing evidence, and readiness outcomes
Results do not use GitHub stars as a quality metric

stories.title: External vision adapters have live contract tests and cost/privacy documentation
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAI and MiniMax requests are verified against current provider APIs
Provider errors propagate to pipeline status
Frame upload, retention, cost, and regional boundaries are documented

stories.title: Public adoption funnel is measured after a canonical GitHub repository exists
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical URL, topics, social preview, releases, and package links are configured
Install-to-first-artifact telemetry is opt-in or measured through public reproducibility reports
The 2000-star target is tracked as a scenario, never promised as an outcome

stories.title: A one-command synthetic demo produces a persistent evidence package
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/run-demo.sh generates a four-second local video and runs the real pipeline without ASR, external vision, or network downloads
Each run creates a new ignored workspace project, refuses collisions, and prints the key artifact paths
CI validates the reported manifest, blocked readiness, demo-receipt/v1, and non-empty evidence artifacts

stories.title: The primary workspace closes the full human review and package finalization loop
acceptanceCriteria: Every shot is reachable and editable in React, including the twenty-fifth and later shots
Low-confidence boundaries require a separate operator assertion bound to the current visual generation
Shot saves are optimistic and recoverable while one explicit finalization commits a fresh package
A browser acceptance receipt proves blocked to ready to mutation-blocked behavior

stories.title: Long local analysis has a durable and recoverable lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: Every UI-started analysis returns a persistent UUID before expensive work begins
Queued, running, cancelling, completed, failed, cancelled, and interrupted states expose stage timing and bounded diagnostics
Retry verifies completed media, visual, audio, and report receipts before resuming
A project-level lease and ownership claim prevent cross-run source, profile, or generation mixing
A completed run binds final media, visual, audio, and report generations
Passwords and external provider credentials are excluded from run records

stories.title: A six-case synthetic benchmark emits an auditable quality receipt
acceptanceCriteria: Generated cases cover hard cuts, fade or dissolve, animation, vertical video, variable frame rate, and an audio-dense speech surrogate
The JSON receipt reports stage timing, boundary metrics, artifacts, readiness, environment, and explicit non-goals
Five declared quality cases pass explicit precision, recall, or false-positive gates while fade or dissolve remains observational
CI runs the benchmark without network, paid providers, or copyrighted source media
Observed fade or dissolve weakness remains visible and is not presented as a passed accuracy threshold

stories.title: Every project produces a provenance-aware audio timeline
acceptanceCriteria: The default local pipeline creates bounded voice, music, sound-effect, silence, and mixed segments without requiring a custom Codex request
Every segment carries timecode, confidence, detector source, and measured, estimated, interpreted, or human-reviewed status
Voice-over and speaker identity remain unknown unless explicitly supported and reviewed
Optional diarization or source-separation failures preserve valid baseline outputs and never trigger an implicit network request

stories.title: Reviewed projects export a client-ready storyboard package
acceptanceCriteria: One validated client export dataset renders the same project content to HTML, Excel, and PDF
The workbook includes overview, complete shot storyboard, VO and on-screen text, music and rhythm, and provenance sheets
Normal analysis and Finalize create no Excel or PDF; export runs only after an explicit UI, CLI, or authorized Codex action
Default generation atomically replaces one stable current package and creates history only when the user explicitly saves a version
A versioned professional template handles fonts, images, wrapping, continuation pages, pagination, and client versus compact density without manual correction
Draft files are visibly unverified and final Excel and PDF downloads remain blocked until the current project is finalized
Export receipts bind media, visual, audio, timeline, review, report, template, and output hashes

stories.title: Audio and client-export quality are measured on redistributable fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic or licensed fixtures cover VO over music, multiple anonymous speakers, SFX, silence, mixed audio, Chinese and English, and no-audio controls
The benchmark reports ASR timing and text error, segment boundaries, supported event precision and recall, export coverage, rendering, runtime, and memory separately
Excel and PDF gates verify images, searchable text, Chinese glyphs, safe cells, metadata, page contract, and current receipts
Generated test documents, rendered pages, frames, browser profiles, and font caches use temporary directories and are removed after successful tests
Private client videos are never committed as benchmark assets
